message.text:
Reflected XSS in the search view (q parameter)

The q value from the URL fragment is written into the DOM with innerHTML and executes script in the victim's session.

errow.impact: A crafted link executes attacker script in the victim's authenticated session.
errow.technical_analysis: The payload in q is reflected unencoded into the result heading.
errow.remediation_steps: Render the value with textContent or the framework's escaping binding and add a restrictive Content-Security-Policy.
errow.counterevidence: No Content-Security-Policy header is sent, so inline handlers are not blocked.

poc.description: Open /#/search?q= in a logged-in browser; the alert fires.
